```yaml
name: Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20, 24]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Upgrade parse-github-url
      run: npm install parse-github-url@1.0.4 --save-dev

    - name: Remove vendored src/lib/parseGitHubUrl.ts
      run: rm src/lib/parseGitHubUrl.ts

    - name: Restore src/lib/version-util.ts and src/package-managers/gitTags.ts
      run: |
        cp .github/patches/version-util.ts src/lib/
        cp .github/patches/gitTags.ts src/package-managers/

    - name: Restore escapeRegExp import from lodash/escapeRegExp
      run: sed -i 's/import { escapeRegExp } from \'.\/lib\/escapeRegExp\';/import { escapeRegExp } from \'lodash\/escapeRegExp\';/' src/lib/version-util.ts

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test
```
